# The system packages Playwright's browsers need on this repository's runner image: the union of
# the `tools`, `chromium`, `firefox` and `webkit` entries of the ubuntu24.04-x64 table in
# playwright-core's lib/coreBundle.js, at the version bun.lock pins, with nothing taken out of it.
#
# .github/scripts/playwright-deps-current.sh holds this list against Playwright's own both ways -
# every name Playwright asks apt for is one this list holds, and every name here is one Playwright
# asks for - and ci.yaml's dispatch job runs it after the install, so a Playwright upgrade that
# moves the list fails that job rather than leaving a browser short of a library.
#
# gstreamer1.0-tools is deliberately not here: it carries the gst-inspect-1.0 that job's decoder
# guard runs, Playwright asks for no such package, and a name here that Playwright does not ask
# for fails that check. The install step adds it beside this list, as its own `step_tools`.
#
# Two readers take this file with blank lines and `#` comments dropped: ci.yaml's dispatch job,
# which installs it, and .github/workflows/ci-caches.yaml's apt-debs job, which downloads the same
# list on a push to main to fill the ~/apt-archives cache entry that job restores. This file holds
# Playwright's list and nothing else, and each of the two writes gstreamer1.0-tools itself beside
# it, so what holds their two sets together is this file plus that one name in each workflow.
fonts-freefont-ttf
fonts-ipafont-gothic

fonts-noto-color-emoji
